Arguing about.en: to disagree with someone in words about something

Asserting possession of.en: to claim that something belongs to you

Disapproving of.en: to think something is bad or wrong

Epitomizing.en: to be a perfect example of something

Exacerbating.en: to make a bad situation worse

Providing resistance to.en: to act against or block something

Redressing.en: to correct something that is wrong or unfair

complicated by.en: made more difficult or confusing by

insensible to.en: not aware of or not affected by
